definitions.explanation: occurring often or at short intervals

examples.japanese: {頻繁|ひんぱん}に{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}る。
この{道路|どうろ}は{事故|じこ}が{頻繁|ひんぱん}に{起|お}きる。
examples.english: Accidents occur frequently on this road.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、{彼|かれ}との{頻繁|ひんぱん}なやり{取|と}りで{疲|つか}れている。
examples.english: Recently, I'm tired from frequent exchanges with him.

notes:
{頻繁|ひんぱん} is a na-adjective meaning frequent or repeated, implying things happen at short intervals.

FORMS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な〜: frequent (modifier)
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に: frequently (adverb — this is the most common form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な{更新|こうしん}: frequent updates
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な{連絡|れんらく}: frequent contact
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に{利用|りよう}する: to use frequently
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に{起|お}きる: to occur frequently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- よく: often (casual, everyday)
- しばしば: often (literary, written)
- たびたび: repeatedly, time and again
- ひっきりなしに: incessantly, without pause

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, よく is more natural. {頻繁|ひんぱん} is common in news, reports, and written Japanese.
